opening.argument: The video opens as a stage announcement that the Base app is available to everyone, then demonstrates its wallet and trading features, including an in-feed token purchase. It also presents creator coins as offering possible upside, USDC rewards for saving dollars, and a promotion tied to signing up, using the app, and inviting friends. Those financial features deserve scrutiny, but the presentation describes what the app offers rather than establishing a deceptive mechanism. The accompanying description expressly says the discussion is not investment advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold a financial product. Nothing in the cited material establishes losses, a completed deceptive transfer, or an outcome beyond the features and promotion presented.
